title: Moving During Kremt Rainy Season in Addis Ababa
excerpt: Wet-season moves: shrink-wrap mattresses, covered loading, mud at compounds, and rescheduling when roads flood near river corridors.
content:
Overview

Kremt rains soak cardboard and muddy compound paths. Professional crews use wrap, mats, and covered truck bays—DIY moves suffer mold and slip injuries.

Material protection

  • Shrink-wrap upholstered furniture even for short carries.
  • Double-bag textiles; elevate boxes on pallets inside truck when possible.
  • Wipe wheels before entering new apartment to protect floors.

Scheduling

Watch daily forecasts; embassy and river-adjacent neighborhoods flood faster. Reschedule early rather than forcing trucks through unsafe mud slopes.

Frequently asked questions

How far in advance should I book? For condos in Bole, Ayat, or Kazanchis, book 1–2 weeks ahead; inter-city and large office moves need 2–4 weeks.

Before moving day

  • Confirm management move rules, freight lift booking, and security ID lists for truck plate and crew.
  • Declutter to reduce volume; label rooms and mark FRAGILE on electronics and glass.
  • Photograph meters and wall condition at origin; repeat at destination before furniture covers walls.
  • Check holiday traffic and end-of-month rush when picking dates.

Moving day
